Admissions Requirements
Welcome to Nova Southeastern University's College of Computing, AI, and Cybersecurity!
We are excited to learn more about your interest in our graduate programs. We are
a world-class institution with a strong reputation for excellence in computing education
and research.
We understand that the decision to pursue graduate studies abroad is a major one.
We are committed to making the admissions process as smooth and transparent as possible
for international students, and we offer a variety of resources and support services
to help you succeed.
We encourage you to apply to our graduate programs if you are passionate about computing
and have the potential to make significant contributions to the field. We look forward
to receiving your application and learning more about you!

Admissions Process
Aside from the general admissions requirements for the College of Computing, AI, and Cybersecurity, international prospects must
follow specific requirements as outlined in the course catalog. These requirements include:
Enrollment Deposit Fee. If you’re using the F-1 visa, an Enrollment Deposit Fee of $500 will be required
to process your accepted I-20. Once you’re officially enrolled in classes, this deposit
will go towards your tuition costs.
This deposit is not refundable in the event of a withdrawal or non-registration.
An I-20 cannot be issued to a provisionally admitted student. All official documents
and the $500 deposit fee must be submitted.
Prerequisite Degree. If your prerequisite degrees were completed outside of the United States, it must
be equivalent to a regionally-accredited United States degree in a related field,
with a GPA meeting the admissions requirements.
To enable the college to determine equivalencies, the applicant must have their degree
evaluated by an agency that is a member of the National Association of Credential
Evaluation Services (NACES). A course-by-course transcript evaluation with a GPA calculation
is required. For current information on evaluation agencies visit www.naces.org/members.
English Proficiency. Applicants whose native language is not English are required to demonstrate English
proficiency. The following standardized tests satisfy the university's English requirement
for nonnative English speakers. Minimum scores must be met. Official test results
must be sent directly from the testing agency to Nova Southeastern University. Institution
codes for sending official scores are listed respectively.
Duolingo English Test
Minimum Score: 105
Institution Code: Nova Southeastern University - Graduate
*Please notify the graduate admissions office when you have sent your test results
to our institution. Allow at least two days for the score to be received.
International English Language Testing System (IELTS)
Minimum score: 6.0 on the Academic test module
Institution Code: 136840 - Nova Southeastern University
Pearson Test of English – (PTE-Academic)
Minimum score: 54 on the computer-based test.
Institution Code: 88M
*Please provide the graduate admissions office with your Score Report Code (SRC) once
you receive it.
Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL)
Minimum score: 4.0 on the new 1-6 scale Internet-based test
*(prior to January 21, 2026, the minimum score is 80 on the 1-120 scale Internet-based
test)
Institution Code: 5514 - Nova Southeastern University
An applicant can qualify for an exemption from taking an English proficiency examination
if one of the following criteria is met:
Successful completion of at least a bachelor's degree at a regionally-accredited U.S.
institution of higher education.
Passing Level 5 with at least 85% at Talk International Language School.
Completion of a degree at an institution in one of the following countries: Australia,
English speaking Canada, Ghana, Ireland, New Zealand, or the United Kingdom.
Note: Master's students can participate and complete their master's program without having
to travel to the United States.

Student Testimonials
May Bantan
Home Country: Saudi Arabia
M.S. in Management Information Systems, '14
I came across NSU when studying English in Miami and I found that South Florida was
a good area to bring up a family. The weather was also very attractive as it was similar
to Saudi Arabia. I had a great NSU experience as I was able to experience a lot. I
became the President of the Saudi Arabia Student organization and I got to meet other
international students and share experiences with them. I found the professors to
be very qualified and I was able to learn more than what the class was about and get
real-life stories and insight into the technology industry. The student life at NSU
is great as they really encourage students to be involved on campus and in the community.
I could have studied this major back home but it is different to be exposed and immersed
in another country's culture and represent your home country and that alone that has
been a great accomplishment for me. NSU is very diverse so it makes it easy for any
student to adapt to the school environment. I'd welcome any international student
to become a part of our NSU community.
Abdul Almutairi
Home Country: Saudi Arabia
M.S. in Management Information Systems, '14
Florida was always my first choice. I attended the University of Tampa for my bachelor's
and heard great things about Nova Southeastern University (NSU) for a graduate degree.
I was happy to compliment my bachelor's degree that was more management oriented with
the M.S. in MIS that focused more on technology. NSU is a great school with nice and
helpful students and I would recommend other international students to join NSU! I
hope to one day become a Data Analyst and NSU has prepared me for this role."
For questions related to obtaining a student visa, please contact the Office of International Students and Scholars by phone at 844-414-6178 or (954) 262-7240. You can also email: intl@nova.edu
Cybersecurity Designations
NSU's M.S. Artificial Intelligence Cybersecurity program is validated by the NSA as a designated Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity
(AICyber) Program of Study, and the M.S. Cyber Defense and M.S. Cybersecurity Management programs are validated by the NSA as designated Cyber Defense (CD) Programs of Study.
NSU’s Ph.D. Computer Science, Ph.D. Cybersecurity Management, and Ph.D. Information Systems programs are validated by the NSA under the CAE-R designation.
